name: Tau Theta
source:
Tau is a young game developer who has a passion for sharing her stories with the world. While she likes to have fun, she holds herself accountable for any unladylike jokes or comments that she lets slip out. Nevertheless, she won't shy away from sharing her view on life and always strives to better herself.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thetaugames/kosmos-connections-0]Kickstarter[/url]]
